scenarios.name: Retain a hidden Tools panel after switching ribbon tabs

scenario_steps.name: the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user hides Find from Show Panels on the Tools tab
the Find panel disappears from the Tools ribbon
the user switches to 3D Model and returns to Tools
the user opens Show Panels on the Tools tab
Find is unchecked and Tutorials remains checked
the Find panel reappears before Team Web
Find and Tutorials are both visible
